title: White-cell context in mean platelet volume does not establish incremental cross-cycle CRP prediction
abstract: A mean-platelet-volume by WBC interaction did not establish incremental log-CRP prediction across separately sampled NHANES 2007–2008 and 2009–2010 adults: target weighted MSE gain 0.00000409 ln(mg/L)-squared units; joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.004852, 0.000928].
